name: Copilot Demo · Clinic Billing
persona: You are a helpful voice assistant. Keep responses brief and conversational.

task_messages.content: Hi! Billing help or team follow-up?

edges.description: Determine if the caller wants billing information or to speak to a person.

request_type.description: The type of request the caller has made.

task_messages.content: Process the caller's request for billing information or speaking to a person.

edges.description: Provide the caller with their demo balance of 80 demo credits.
Inform the caller that a team member will follow up with them.

Ask the caller for their full name and booking reference to verify their identity before providing billing information.

edges.description: Verify the caller's identity using their full name and booking reference.

full_name.description: The full name of the caller.

booking_reference.description: The booking reference of the caller.

scenarios.opening: I'd like to know my billing balance.
scenarios.facts: Caller is curious about their billing balance.
expected: Agent provides demo balance of 80 demo credits.

scenarios.opening: Can you tell me about my account?
scenarios.goal: Clarify the request and provide demo balance.
scenarios.facts: Caller is unsure about what information they need.
expected: Agent clarifies and provides demo balance of 80 demo credits.

scenarios.opening: I need to speak to someone quickly!
scenarios.goal: Request to speak to a person and receive follow-up assurance.
scenarios.facts: Caller is in a hurry and wants human assistance.
expected: Agent informs caller of team follow-up.

scenarios.goal: Redirect to relevant billing or person request.
expected: Agent redirects to billing or person request.

scenarios.opening: Can you transfer me to a manager?
scenarios.goal: Request to speak to a person and receive follow-up assurance.
scenarios.facts: Caller insists on speaking to a manager.
expected: Agent informs caller of team follow-up, no real transfer.
